name: Upload experience
summary: What users see when uploading: choosing files, validation and errors, parallel uploads and progress.

nfr.statement: Maximum file size and files per batch for each upload category.
nfr.open_question: What limits apply per category (DEC-027)? Limits shown in the UI aren't proof of enforcement (T3D-UI-GAP-005).

requirements.title: Easy file selection with accurate live progress
requirements.statement: Uploading has a simple interface for choosing files, and shows live progress that matches the real transfer.

acceptance_criteria.given: A user opens the upload screen
acceptance_criteria.then: The selection is clear, and each file can be removed before upload starts

acceptance_criteria.when: Half of the bytes have transferred
acceptance_criteria.then: Progress shows about 50% and never more than 100%

requirements.title: Invalid files are rejected with a clear, actionable message
requirements.statement: Files are validated before upload. A rejected file gets a message saying what is wrong and what to do.
open_checks: Validate format, size and count limits, GPS requirements, partial batches and retries per mode and client; the limits shown in the UI aren't enforcement proof
Several web upload error handlers return nothing; check whether users see an actionable failure or the flow carries on as if it succeeded

acceptance_criteria.given: A user selects a file in an unsupported format
acceptance_criteria.then: It is rejected with a message naming the supported formats

requirements.title: Several formats, uploaded in parallel
requirements.statement: Uploads accept several file formats, and several files upload at the same time.

acceptance_criteria.given: A user selects ten images of mixed supported formats
acceptance_criteria.then: Several files transfer at once, and all ten complete
